title: 1970s Couple Outdoors, Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot from the mid-1970s featuring a young man and woman strolling arm-in-arm across a grassy field. The man wears a double-breasted wide-lapel coat and flared trousers characteristic of 1970s casual fashion, while the woman carries a rolled umbrella. The background displays a softly blurred rural or park setting with trees and a small structure.
